item.title: SEGA newsletter data breach exposes 2.2 million email addresses
item.dc:creator: Bill Toulas
item.description: Japanese gaming giant SEGA has disclosed that a data breach at its third-party newsletter provider, ARARA, exposed the email addresses of 2.2 million newsletter subscribers. [...]

item.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" published
item.dc:creator: Lawrence Abrams
item.description: N-able has taken its hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down their servers after a security researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, including exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable systems.
